name: Halong Bay Heritage Marathon
short_description: A road race over four distances (42.195 km, 21.1 km, 10 km and 5 km) on Sunday 22 November 2026 in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam.
ai_summary: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon is a road race scheduled for Sunday 22 November 2026 in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam, with a race weekend from 20 to 22 November. Runners choose from four distances: the 42.195 km marathon, a 21.1 km half marathon, 10 km and 5 km. The races start on Tran Quoc Nghien street and finish by the Quang Ninh Planning, Fair and Exhibition Palace, with the marathon run out and back along the Ha Long - Cam Pha coast road.

core_facts.venue: Quang Ninh Planning, Fair and Exhibition Palace, Tran Quoc Nghien street, Ha Long ward

pros: Fast, fully closed out-and-back course on the Ha Long coast road; 2:13:57 race record in 2025
Water and medical posts about every 2 km on the marathon course
Four distances: marathon, half marathon, 10 km and 5 km
Big field of over 14,000 runners, more than 3,000 from abroad
cons: Tight marathon checkpoint: 26 km within 3 hours 50 in 2025
Ha Long is about three and a half hours by bus from Hanoi
No refunds; transfers cost 300,000 VND and closed about seven weeks before the 2025 race
Fake social-media pages have sold bogus bibs for the 2026 race; register only through official channels

faqs.question: When is the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Halong Bay Heritage Marathon is on Sunday 22 November 2026 in Ha Long, Quang Ninh, Vietnam. All four races are on that morning: the marathon starts at 4am, the half marathon at 5am, the 10 km at 6am and the 5 km at 7.30am. The 2026 race is the event's eleventh edition.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon?
faqs.answer: The race offers four distances: a 42.195 km marathon, which is the headline race, a 21.1 km half marathon, a 10 km and a 5 km. The marathon runs out and back along the Ha Long - Cam Pha coast road to a U-turn near the Km6 Quang Hanh fuel depot; the half turns after the Khe Ca junction.

faqs.question: Where is the Halong Bay Heritage Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The start and finish are in Ha Long ward, Quang Ninh. Runners start on Tran Quoc Nghien street near 30 October Square and finish on 30 October street by the Quang Ninh Planning, Fair and Exhibition Palace. Hanoi's Noi Bai Airport is the usual arrival point, and the bus from Hanoi takes about three and a half hours.
